thread.title: Buffett says he bought a 'just a little' more Apple recently - MarketWatch

author: William L. Watts
title: Buffett says he bought a 'just a little' more Apple recently - MarketWatch
text:
Billionaire investor Warren Buffett on Thursday said he had bought "just a little" more of Apple Inc. AAPL, +0.86% in an interview with CNBC . Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway Inc. BRK.A, -0.25% [s:brkb] revealed in a regulatory filing earlier this month that it had bought 12.4 million shares of Apple in the second quarter to a total of nearly 252 million shares as of June 30. Apple shares were up 0.4%.
